conclusion: Generic TechnologyAcquire directly passes its technology ID to a function that compares it with building +0x42 across a live-count loop and wonder +0x44 across 33 positions. These are additional static consumers of the accepted technology fields. The two loops do not directly read definition text; the list's downstream purpose and runtime behavior remain unresolved.
